fields.Name: W1 -> S5.1
fields.Description: Gate G2.29 (phase 2, dataset W1, criterion S5.1): every W1-signal s42 training run references a protocol row created before its first candidate started, 100%, and a search with no protocol is refused, 1 of 1. The refusal is read as the operation's result code PROTOCOL_REQUIRED, with no run row. It fails when ProtocolSearchGuard.RequireProtocolForSearch accepts a null protocol (refusedWithoutProtocol false).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Both W1 runs reference a protocol row created before them, and the no-protocol training is refused with PROTOCOL_REQUIRED and no run row.
